Call for pitch decks

Ideation of International Business SME 2027 pitching competition

Have a business idea that could grow from Malaysia to the world? Show your creativity, innovation and entrepreneurial spirit, and pitch how AI and digital tools can help a Malaysian SME go global.

Think big, pitch smart, and take Malaysian businesses global. Your pitch is evaluated by an industry jury.

1st place
RM300
2nd place
RM200
3rd place
RM100

Every participant receives SCORUN points and a Certificate of Participation.

When and where

Wednesday, 25 November 2026
Pitching at 11.30 AM
Awards at 12.30 PM
Theatre Hall, UNITEN Putrajaya Campus

Who can join

  • Students from Business, IT and Engineering
  • Teams of 2 to 3 members; mixing programmes is welcome

Format

  • 3-minute pitch, strictly timed
  • 10-slide pitch deck (PPT or PDF)
  • Any business idea is accepted

How to enter

  1. Register your team

    Two or three members. Register here; a mix of Business, IT and Engineering makes a stronger pitch.

  2. Build your deck

    Use the pitch deck template and follow the 10-slide structure below.

  3. Submit by 15 Nov, 6.00 PM

    Upload your deck as PPT or PDF through the submission form.

  4. Pitch on 25 Nov

    Present for 3 minutes at 11.30 AM in the Theatre Hall. Winners are announced at 12.30 PM.

Your 10-slide pitch deck

Slide 6 carries the most weight in this year’s theme: tell the jury which country you will enter first, how, and why.

1

Front page

Name, logo, tagline, team and programmes.

2

Problem

The market gap, who faces it, and your evidence.

3

Solution

What is new and how AI or digital tech is used.

4

Market opportunity

Target customers and market size, at home and abroad.

5

Business model

Revenue, pricing, costs and sales channels.

6

International business strategy

Target market, entry mode, localisation, AI enablers, risks.

7

Competitive advantage

Main competitors and why customers choose you.

8

Roadmap

Milestones over 12 to 24 months.

9

Team members

Name, programme, role and skills.

10

Seeking fund

Amount, what investors receive, use of funds.

How the jury scores you

Innovation and your international strategy together make up half of the score. Rehearse so you finish inside 3 minutes.

  • Innovation and originality25%
  • International business strategy25%
  • Business viability20%
  • Use of AI and digital technology15%
  • Presentation and time management15%

FusionQB helps businesses connect customer data, improve customer engagement and simplify daily operations through digital solutions. We provide Customer Data Platforms (CDP), loyalty and engagement programmes, business apps and customised systems for sales ordering, performance tracking and customer service.
